pipeline: The deploy pipeline registers each agent at deploy time, so registration is the precondition for reaching production.
registry: The Agent Registry entry records the agent's owner, declared scope and expiry, and the credential is issued from it.
issuer: The workload-identity issuer mints a distinct, attributable identity the agent carries across every hop and protocol, scoped to least privilege.
agent: The agent acts under its own scoped, short-lived credential, so its actions can be attributed, contained and revoked.
tool: The downstream tool or API the agent calls; channel authentication secures that one hop, kept separate from the agent's workload identity.
audit: Every call is logged under the agent's own identity, giving the tamper-proof, per-identity attribution an auditor relies on.
